story.title: Story 3: The Adapter and the Seven Prompts

result.reviewScopeSummary: Verified Story 3 against AC-2.1 through AC-2.5 and TC-2.1 through TC-2.3, including adapter code, prompt registry/modules, provenance copy sites, focused tests, prompt goldens, POC smoothing prompt source, and configured gates. One blocking TC-2.2 production-path bounding issue remains.

newFindings.title: Tool-result bounding can exceed maxInputChars for small valid configs
newFindings.evidence: TC-2.2 requires oversized summarizeToolResult input to render head + tail + marker under maxInputChars. src/sdk.ts accepts any positive maxInputChars, but src/inference/adapter.ts:30-36 builds a truncation marker and returns it even when marker.length exceeds maxInputChars. Reproduced from the same formula with maxInputChars=10 and 1000 chars of content: markerLength=75, boundedLength=75, so the rendered input is over the configured bound. The existing test at test/inference-prompts.test.ts:219-233 only covers MAX_INPUT_CHARS=200, where the marker is shorter than the bound.

verified: AC-2.1 / TC-2.1: all seven DerivationProvider operations exist on the adapter, seeded drains land all seven kinds ready, and deterministic-provider handler equivalence is covered by inference-adapter.test.ts.
AC-2.2: adapter uses assignment.prompt to render messages, shaped provider text becomes form content, and adversarial provider prose does not change record-stamped outcomes or receipts.

AC-2.3: seven named prompt modules exist, registry/default names cover all seven kinds, six non-smoothing prompts are marked PRE-DIAL-IN, goldens cover all seven, and smoothing-v1 matches the POC system prompt source.
AC-2.4 / TC-2.3: whitespace-only success is classified as retryable empty_output, retry can land ready, and exhaustion lands failed with provider_failure plus lastError naming empty_output.
AC-2.5 / TC-2.1: ready adapter forms carry assignment-stamped provider/model/prompt provenance, and deterministic-provider forms carry no provenance.

TC-2.2 partial: prompt goldens, fixture embedding, single-turn shape, registry completeness, brief receipt stripping, and normal-case tool-result bounding at maxInputChars=200 are covered and passing.
unverified: TC-2.2 full input-bounding contract for all valid maxInputChars values: values below the truncation marker length exceed the configured bound.

gatesRun.command: cd packages/lhc && pnpm exec vitest run test/inference-adapter.test.ts test/inference-prompts.test.ts

productionPathFindings: src/inference/adapter.ts boundContent can emit bounded tool-result content longer than the configured maxInputChars when maxInputChars is shorter than the truncation marker.
additionalObservations: No fake adapter, shim, placeholder, or mock path was found in production inference code; test fakes are confined to test fixtures.
The configured gates pass, but they do not cover the small-valid-maxInputChars counterexample.
